items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: He really could play Happy Shillings. I think he played jazz quite a bit.

ctx.x: His mother owned homes where my aunt lived in one of them on Annunciation and what's the street before Louisiana Avenue? Pleasant or Tulledana? Tulledana. Those homes on Pleasant and Tulledana. He really could play Happy Shillings. I think he played jazz quite a bit. And you heard him play? Yeah, he played quite a bit and used to go over to my uncle's that lived right on. He had a big grocery and bar. My mother's brother had a grocery and bar.
